description: The lifetime mutant of v8-engine-platform-path-dialog that needs AddressSanitizer to be caught reliably (CI runs no sanitizer). Killed only on an AddressSanitizer build of platform_sdl_tests (configure with -fsanitize=address), run with SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy: the use-after-free shows as an ASan report, or as the freed mutex failing to lock, or as a crash (2026-11-01, framework-rework decision on the sanitizer mutants). Run with run_mutations.py --catalog this file --build-dir <the ASan build>.

mutants.what: A pending dialog does not share the mailbox, so an answer after the platform is gone writes freed memory
